environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) behind an AWS Network Load Balancer (NLB, Layer 4 TCP passthrough). Security group allows inbound TCP/443 from 0.0.0.0/0. TLS terminated at the application via gunicorn with ssl context. No application-layer proxy or filtering in front of the Flask app. The /api/users/search endpoint is publicly accessible.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB (TCP passthrough, no HTTP inspection)
